append.detail: 2026-10-06: push_devices (migration 20270346001500, own-row read and delete, service-role writes) holds native tokens; POST/DELETE /api/v1/push/devices register and revoke for the verified caller; sendPushToProfile runs the one send gate then both transports, web push and the Expo transport in lib/push-native.ts (prunes DeviceNotRegistered, inert without EXPO_ACCESS_TOKEN); /api/status reports monitoring.nativePush.
